title: Communication: Building together
characterDescription: a young female deer with your boss at work
concept:
You and your boss don’t know the answer, so you work together to figure it out, combining your knowledge.
This rarely works, but you will be highly valued if you achieve this.
Both sides need to have the capability to discuss the issue at the same level,
You will also need trustworthy relationship, where you are comfortable expressing your honest opinions.
